purpose: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: consolidated ash-flow rock with flattened lens-like inclusions. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Both views show one consolidated squat rose-taupe mass with sloped top, broad planes and horizontally flattened dark lenticules. Front concept has a deep offset fracture; rear varies the top outline and number of small lenses. Freeze one coherent original broad angular mass with sloped stepped top, not a field specimen copy. Preserve larger tapered lenticules as actual weathered shallow relief cavities, subordinate quiet matrix and medium/small lens rhythm. Do not reproduce concept speckled texture or its inconsistent minor fractures; no round clasts or continuous bedding stripes.
